name: PD-Codes API
description: Provides metadata and artwork for Movies, Series and Episodes from a private PD-Codes API v5 deployment. Identifies items by TMDB, IMDb, TheTVDB, MyAnimeList or AniList id where Jellyfin already has one, and falls back to a name search. Requires the API base URL to be configured; there is no public instance.
overview: Metadata and images from a self-hosted PD-Codes API (v5) instance.

versions.changelog: Fixed GetSearchResults on the Movie and Series providers: each candidate type (movie/anime, anime/tv) is now tried and caught separately instead of sharing one try/catch around the whole loop. Previously a slow or failing type (e.g. "tv") could discard search results already found for another type (e.g. "anime") in the same request, so Jellyfin's Identify dialog showed nothing at all for titles the API actually had - "Happy Sugar Life" was the case that surfaced it. Also includes 1.0.0.1's automatic manifest.json update on release (no plugin behavior change).
